information.pdf.formula_or_claim: Directional likelihood information for the original concentrated-input contact fixture at $t=16$. The generating normal is $n_0=e_3$, $X_0=(e_1,e_2)$, and the plane graph chart has $z=(z_1,z_2)^\top$ and normal $n(z)=(n_0-X_0z)/\sqrt{1+\|z\|^2}$. Panel (a) shows equal values of the exact divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p_0\|p_z)=z^T\mathcal F_{\mathrm{cond}}z/[2(1+\|z\|^2)]$ in native chart coordinates, with equal axis scales. These are likelihood-divergence contours, not credible or confidence regions. Panel (b) evaluates the same divergence along the two native information directions; $\delta$ is the physical angle between $n_0$ and $n(z)$. supp_information_tracking.pdf.proposed_latex_caption: Directional likelihood information for the original concentrated-input contact fixture at $t=16$. The generating normal is $n_0=e_3$, $X_0=(e_1,e_2)$, and the plane graph chart has $z=(z_1,z_2)^\top$ and normal $n(z)=(n_0-X_0z)/\sqrt{1+\|z\|^2}$. For the same frozen prescribed inputs and true variance, $p_z$ is the joint Gaussian response law with means $P_{\mathcal X(z)}v_j$ and covariance $\sigma^2I_3$. Panel (a) shows equal values of the exact divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p_0\|p_z)=z^T\mathcal F_{\mathrm{cond}}z/[2(1+\|z\|^2)]$ in native chart coordinates, with equal axis scales. These are likelihood-divergence contours, not credible or confidence regions. Panel (b) evaluates the same divergence along the two native information directions; $\delta$ is the physical angle between $n_0$ and $n(z)$. The marked rotations $5^\circ$ and $30^\circ$ produce nearly equal divergences, approximately $0.2396$ and $0.2308$, despite their different angular sizes. Thus this input design distinguishes rotations much more strongly in one direction. The local limit is $D_{\mathrm{KL}}=\tfrac12z^T\mathcal F_{\mathrm{cond}}z+o(\|z\|^2)$. This is expected observation-law information at the generating plane, distinct from finite-data posterior curvature. No new observations, inference, fitting, or experimental repetitions are introduced. Invariant-density Hessian and local accuracy diagnostics. Empirical bounded log-coordinate spread is compared with $H_A^{-1}$ only under recorded locality conditions; broad/nonlocal cases remain visible. The stationary inverse-Fisher study uses fixed known variances and $\beta=1$, reports estimation bias and local fractions, and treats inverse Fisher as a local reference rather than a global intrinsic Cramer--Rao equality. The real graph-density volume term is a separate quantity, retained in the tables. Forgetting sampling references use squared weights. Recomputed sharp fixed-time envelope $\sqrt{\min(k,n-k)}\,\epsilon_t/(\gamma_t-\epsilon_t)$ under $\epsilon_t<\gamma_t/2$, with the exact aggregate conditional drift and the appropriate real/complex constants. True path, gap and drift are analysis quantities, not online confidence radii. Invalid conditions remain marked and receive no violation test. Error bands describe across-simulation spread. The geometric ceiling is not used to clip the theorem. Phase tables and exact binomial violation intervals retain every declared condition.

prediction.causal_warm_start: One current-parameter warm start per completed block; if signal variance is zero, also use a declared positive interior fallback. Multiple-start stationary reference experiments are retained separately.
prediction.validation_scoring_scope: Policy validation uses independent observed held-out disturbance power or noisy held-out KKT response MSE. Hidden subspaces, normals and true covariance losses never select settings. Optional predictive density reports are not computed during task-policy selection.
prediction.primary_beam_generator_seeds: SeedSequence([validation_seed or test_seed + seed_offset, 32, episode, 31]); same draws across interventions

theory.variance_convention: Real noise covariance sigma2 I; proper-complex covariance sigma2 I and real/imag component variance sigma2/2.
theory.specification: Supplied v5.tex main and supplementary(14).tex, theory and appendices; final_simulation_guide.md. Global KL, information loss, invariant versus graph curvature, aggregate drift, sharp bound and information-gap identity reconciled against source text.
theory.repetition_unit: Independent signal/noise episode; no posterior node or query is an independent performance episode.
theory.inference_scope: Numerical native rank one/codimension one; information algebra also checks other ranks. No deterministic general-rank moment scaling claim.
theory.reference_budget_scope: One bounded pre-freeze independent-quadrature refinement; statistical cases, seeds and performance budgets unchanged. Extreme span40000 is retained at the same declared cap.

historical_geometry.interpretation: Deterministic posterior geometry; quadrature nodes are not independent Monte Carlo repeats.
historical_geometry.density_measure: q_A with respect to normalized invariant real projective measure; uniform density is one.
historical_geometry.parameter_semantics: A is the NORMAL-LINE parameter. The contact tangent-plane parameter is -A; psi_plane(-A)=-tr(A)+psi_line(A).
historical_geometry.primary_control: A1 and A2 have identical mode and entire centered chordal-distance distribution by complementary-coordinate permutation.
historical_geometry.axial_control: q_(kappa P_mode) matches mean modal overlap and r_rms, not the complete distance CDF or necessarily rho95.
historical_geometry.region_bound: Bounds are on ||n n^T v||, the normal/blocked component. They are not admissible-plane speed bounds.
historical_geometry.action: Paper Eq36 for the complementary plane, H=I+lambda E[nn^T]. A soft expected penalty, not a hard contact controller.
historical_geometry.selection: All matrices, numerical budgets, queries and lambda are fixed by this configuration before evaluation.

historical_em.model: One constant subspace and one fixed boundary prior per disjoint block
historical_em.variance_convention: Real per-coordinate variance; proper-complex covariance, not real/imaginary variance
historical_em.selection: Largest normalized block evidence among positive-signal starts; zero boundary is a declared initialization diagnostic
historical_em.performance_scope: Finite disjoint-block noise estimates, not online adaptation, theorem-scale estimation or global EM convergence
historical_em.guide_source: Uploaded implementation_prompt.md; named main.tex/supplementary.tex unavailable in checkout
